reasons.correctness: The port, properties, adapter and CurrencyConversionService match the interface. Codes match case-insensitively, PLN returns 1, and results use scale 2 HALF_UP. A missing rate throws BusinessRuleTranslatableException(key, isoCode). Hidden tests 5/5 and build green.
reasons.convention_fit: ExchangeRatePort sits in currency/port and FixedExchangeRateAdapter in currency/adapter. Dependencies come in through explicit constructors. The key is added to messages_en and messages_pl. Both unit test classes use MockitoExtension. No convention broken.
reasons.design_fit: The service depends only on the port. Config-backed rates sit with the adapter, and the existing VatRegistryPort/RegistryProperties pattern is reused. The footprint is minimal. Minor: the linear map scan and the redundant PLN entry in application.yml.
reasons.test_quality: CurrencyConversionServiceUnitTest checks multiplication, the HALF_UP boundary, and the exception key and args. FixedExchangeRateAdapterUnitTest checks PLN=1 in both cases, case-insensitive lookup, and an unknown code. No Spring context. The null isoCode path is not tested.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the existing Port/Adapter files, the currency entities and the TranslatableException classes before any edit. The agent then read VatRegistryPort, BialaListaVatAdapter and RegistryProperties as examples and mirrored their structure.
